data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005's second least fixpoint for edge construction is compatible with SRC_014's anchor-library calibration only if the build_att union is monotone on the same lattice; otherwise anchored edge patterns can introduce non-monotone jumps and the second fixpoint is not unique. Refuted if there is an anchor library with two canonical runs that produce conflicting attack edges and no unique least fixed point exists.
